# HEVC references through the AVD command builder

**AI disclosure:** This report, model and prose were generated by AI at the
repository owner's request. Maintainer self-review; no independent review is claimed.
This is the bounded offline decision for [companion #58](https://github.com/iconidentify/omarchy-m1-video/issues/58),
a research child of [driver #42](https://github.com/iconidentify/libva-v4l2_request/issues/42).

**The next discriminating measurement is AVD's actual reference lookup and command
construction around decode pictures 24–34.** The public metadata predicts the same
logical references and intra/inter history for both clients. At GStreamer's first
wrong picture, the expected collocated reference is intra, so the source should
suppress its motion-data read. The kernel can silently substitute the current
output buffer when timestamp lookup fails; the existing userspace traces cannot
observe that decision. No lookup failure, wrong kernel state, or firmware defect
has been demonstrated. No decoder behavior or support count changes here.

## Reproduced result

The [accepted captures](../hevc-controls/captures/2026-09-17/README.md) remain
immutable inputs: ten complete 300-frame runs on one M1. RPS_B is exact; RPS_E has
26 wrong VA outputs and 25 wrong direct-V4L2 outputs. These are previously captured
measurements, not new hardware runs. This model processes **all 300 pictures of all
four selected traces**, then publishes a [24–34 window](window.md) and a
[machine-readable decision](decision.json). Buffer generations count observed
writers; they are not kernel allocation generations.

| Comparison over 300 pictures | RPS_B differences | RPS_E differences |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Logical DPB membership, slice references, expected intra state and motion gate | 0 | 0 |
| Reference-header sequence, conditional on slice POC = decode POC | 239 | 262 |
| Explicit L0/L1 command words | 208 | 251 |
| Known bits of motion-reference command | 0 | 0 |

These are source-derived predictions, **not recorded firmware commands**. Header
sequences differ because submitted slots differ; remapped list words still select
the same logical pictures. RPS_B has such differences with completely correct
pixels. RPS_E's earlier capture report counted 271 differing DPB layouts; nine are
I-pictures, for which `set_header()` does not emit the reference table. That leaves
262 differing predicted emitted sequences. The model retains all DPB metadata but
does not invent a table emission for I-pictures.

Both paths use ten I-pictures and 290 B-pictures in each vector. VA uses 17 capture
buffer indices, GStreamer 19; expected destination reuse counts are 283 and 281.
No stale earlier-writer POC, destination alias or repeated POC appears in this
bounded metadata. This does not certify the kernel's live buffer state.

## First-failure expectations

Output indices are zero-based; decode pictures are one-based. GStreamer's first
wrong **displayed** output is 26/POC26, which belongs to decode picture 32. Its
earliest wrong **decode** picture is 29/POC28. VA first fails at 31/POC31.

At RPS_E picture 29/POC28, both clients select L0/L1 `[32,16]`, with collocated POC32
(the preceding CRA I-picture 28). VA expects buffer 13, third traced writer;
GStreamer expects buffer 11, second writer. `update_dec_buf_info()` predicts
`is_intra=true` on that reference. Consequently `ref_valid` is false regardless
of the missing dependent-segment flag, **provided lookup returns that buffer and
its state agrees with the prior writer**. The predicted motion command has
known mask `0xffffff91`, known value `0x2d008890`; bits 1–3,5,6 remain unknown. Its
motion-address command should be absent under those assumptions.

At VA's first wrong picture 31/POC31, collocated POC30 is inter. The dependent-segment
flag is unrecorded, so the full motion gate remains unknown; do not silently set
it true. Its known mask/value are `0xfffbff91` / `0x2d008880`. Only the ten I-picture
motion words per trace are completely known (`0x2d020000`). The remaining 290 words
have missing inputs even when their known bits agree.

GStreamer's wrong POC28 then supplies references for subsequent wrong pictures.
That is compatible with error propagation, but neither the graph nor output hashes
identify the original cause. The correct RPS_B window contains intra-collocated
pictures too. No speculative reorder or generic VA workaround is justified.

## Source chain and shipped patches

All primary sources are pinned to Asahi Linux commit
`94fb23346d522edf53722357c426a3e58030beea`, tag `asahi-7.1.13-3`.
[source-map.json](source-map.json) records paths, exact SHA-256 values, functions,
all capture-input hashes, checker identity and all 15 shipped patch hashes.
The concatenated patch hash begins `029f57377a00`, matching the capture provenance.
No kernel source or patch was changed or applied to the system.

| Source/function | Fact used by the model |
| --- | --- |
| [`avd-hevc.c`](https://github.com/AsahiLinux/linux/blob/94fb23346d522edf53722357c426a3e58030beea/drivers/media/platform/apple/avd/avd-hevc.c): `set_header`, `stream_refs` | I-picture table skipped; inter-picture table follows submitted DPB order, with count, long-term flag and slice-to-reference POC delta |
| Same: `stream_slice_dqtblk` | L0/L1 words encode submitted DPB slot, list and position |
| Same: `stream_slice_mv`, `stream_slices` | I early return; P implicitly selects L0; B uses the collocated-list flag; one captured slice means `is_first=true`; gate also needs TMVP, nondependent segment and non-intra reference |
| Same: `update_dec_buf_info`, `avd_hevc_run` | Destination `hevc.is_intra` is overwritten from the first slice before command construction |
| Same: `mv_color_size`, preamble and `stream_slice_mv` | Motion storage lies at the plane tail; size derives from negotiated width/height, not necessarily displayed/cropped dimensions |
| [`avd-drv.c`](https://github.com/AsahiLinux/linux/blob/94fb23346d522edf53722357c426a3e58030beea/drivers/media/platform/apple/avd/avd-drv.c): `avd_get_ref_buf` | A missing timestamp returns the destination buffer, without an error result |
| [`videobuf2-v4l2.c`](https://github.com/AsahiLinux/linux/blob/94fb23346d522edf53722357c426a3e58030beea/drivers/media/common/videobuf2/videobuf2-v4l2.c): `vb2_find_buffer` | First buffer by index with `copied_timestamp` set and matching timestamp; an unused zero timestamp alone does not match |
| [`avd-v4l2.c`](https://github.com/AsahiLinux/linux/blob/94fb23346d522edf53722357c426a3e58030beea/drivers/media/platform/apple/avd/avd-v4l2.c): `avd_run_preamble` | Applies request controls, copies source metadata to destination and stores compressed-plane layout |
| [`avd-inst.h`](https://github.com/AsahiLinux/linux/blob/94fb23346d522edf53722357c426a3e58030beea/drivers/media/platform/apple/avd/avd-inst.h), [`bitfield.h`](https://github.com/AsahiLinux/linux/blob/94fb23346d522edf53722357c426a3e58030beea/include/linux/bitfield.h) | Exact masks, shifts and modulo bit encoding; macro name `SLICE_B` is the valid-reference bit, not simply slice type |

Patch 0006 applies request controls before HEVC reads them; 0010 copies dynamic
slice/entry-point arrays under the control lock; 0011 fixes bounds and error
completion. Those shipped fixes must remain in the later experiment. They do not
change the modeled reference/header/list/MV expressions or expected `is_intra`
update. Patch 0005 changes shared job synchronization and 0012 cleanup; this model
makes no runtime synchronization claim. Patch 0007 changes 4:2:2 compressed chroma
sizing, preserving current 4:2:0 behavior. Patches0009/0015 validate formats; the
remaining codec-specific changes are H.264. The per-patch inventory records all
of them; this is source reconciliation, not proof of resident module contents.

The HEVC command builder does not read `poc_lt_curr`. Reordering that list solely
because it was the earliest strict trace difference would not change this builder's
reference-table expression. Missing fields still prevent comparing all commands.

## Deliberate unknowns and model domain

The normalized trace records decode POC, not `slice_pic_order_cnt`. Reference-header
low 17 bits therefore remain unknown. A separately labeled conditional value shows
what the header would be **if those POCs agree**. It is not upgraded to observed
truth using unavailable private controls. Signed subtraction outside int32 is
rejected; valid negative deltas use the source's low 17-bit encoding.

The trace also omits merge-candidate count, dependent-segment/CABAC/MVD flags and
inactive P-slice L1 count. A partial command carries a known-bit mask and explicit
unknown inputs; `value` stays null until all bits are known. Intra and TMVP-disabled
short-circuit cases are handled separately. The kernel still performs a lookup
before its TMVP gate for non-I slices, but inactive collocated bytes are absent
from the schema; that lookup is explicitly unavailable.

Actual timestamps, `copied_timestamp`, buffer availability, the returned kernel
buffer, resident `is_intra`, physical addresses, negotiated dimensions/plane lengths,
compressed-reference contents and complete controls are unobserved here. Symbolic
addresses never substitute invented numbers. A lookup miss could change the selected
writer and motion gate; this is a testable branch, not evidence that it happened.

The model accepts one context/run, one complete progressive slice/request per
picture, unique POCs and an explicit full extent. Unsupported batches, fields,
POC epochs, missing/stale writers and destination aliases reject. The trusted
checker runs first, followed by these stricter model-domain checks. Other codecs,
multislice streams, dynamic reconfiguration, firmware execution and failed-job
state are outside this deliverable. Parent #42 still owns cause/fix, three exact
RPS_E runs, RPS_B preservation, the full 147-vector suite and fault/concurrency checks.

## Reproduce and test without a decoder

Python3 and a GCC/Clang-compatible C compiler for the independent macro test are
sufficient. No kernel headers, module, licensed media or Apple machine is needed.
Use the trusted driver checker at `ba66572ff7e1e380377eb2414a7eb7d7f97bb0d9`:

```sh
export HEVC_REFTRACE_CHECKER=/absolute/driver/tests/hevc-reftrace-check.py
python3 experiments/hevc-avd-map/tests.py
python3 experiments/hevc-avd-map/report.py --verify
```

`report.py --write` regenerates only this research directory's decision/window;
it checks immutable inputs first. All 16 test groups pass, including changed-capture and untrusted-checker rejection.
The tests include correctly remapped permutations,
a wrong remap, buffer reuse from intra to inter, stale writers, missing fields,
I/P/TMVP semantics and timestamp-zero/fallback cases. C evaluates the verbatim
upstream macro excerpt against 821 header/list/I/partial-motion cases. These are
model cases, not decoded frames or independent hardware trials.

To independently verify source custody, download each `source-map.json` kernel
entry from its pinned repository path into a flat directory, retaining its basename.
For example, `gh api repos/AsahiLinux/linux/contents/PATH?ref=REVISION -H
'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw+json'` returns the original bytes. Then run:

```sh
python3 experiments/hevc-avd-map/verify_sources.py /absolute/pinned-source-directory
```

This verifies all 11 primary source/license files and the exact 19 extracted macro
definitions. Hosted CI runs model/regression/reproduction checks without hardware;
it does not refetch source, install a module or expose a self-hosted runner.
The mandatory companion syntax/mock rebuild baseline also applies before merge.

The [next instrumentation proposal](INSTRUMENTATION.md) names the missing observations,
source locations, expected distinctions and finite acceptance/stop conditions.
It is a design only; executing it requires a separate kernel/hardware scope.
